measure: step-to-step sd of training bits/token, window-matched
caveat: one 9-point window of run 2 against 70 of run 1. Run 1 HAD calm windows -- 12 of 70 were calmer than run 2 -- because sitting inside one homogeneous shard is quiet for a different reason than mixing shards is. The claim supported is that run 2 is calmer than a TYPICAL run-1 window, not yet that it is calm consistently.
